list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A separated ion pair with a κ²-bound nitrate on the mononuclear Ce(III) silylamide anion and a cryptand-encapsulated lithium counterion.

synthesis.procedure: React Ce(NR₂)₃ (R = SiMe₃) with LiNO₃ in THF in the presence of 2,2,2-cryptand; the main article does not give numerical reagent quantities.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for reaction; −25 °C for crystallization
synthesis.time: 20 min before and 20 min after cryptand addition; two successive 24 h crystallizations
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirring under dinitrogen in a glovebox or on a Schlenk line
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as a yellow crystalline solid after work-up.

SI, Experimental, small-scale and larger-scale syntheses of 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The mononuclear Ce(IV) anion has a terminal oxo ligand and pseudo-tetrahedral geometry at Ce. The oxo ligand is not coordinated by the cryptand-bound lithium counterion.

synthesis.procedure: Photolyze a solution of 1 in 2:1 toluene-d₈/pyridine-d₅ using a 380 nm LED lightstrip for 6 h at −5 °C. The main article gives no numerical amount of precursor 1.

reagents.amount: 40.0 mg, 0.037 mmol (small scale); 264.6 mg, 0.248 mmol (larger scale)
reagents.name: complex 1

synthesis.vessel_or_method: Photolysis in an NMR tube equipped with a J-Young valve; 380 nm LED lightstrip
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as yellow plates after reaction work-up.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A partial-cubane Ce₃O₄ core contains one μ₃-oxo and three μ₂-oxo ligands. Each Ce bears two silylamide ligands; two cryptand-bound lithium ions are counterions. The Fig. 3 caption notes a diethyl ether solvate without establishing its stoichiometry in the supplied text.

synthesis.procedure: Formed alongside 2 and 4 during photolysis of 1 under the reported 380 nm, −5 °C conditions. The main article does not report numerical precursor quantities or a separate preparative procedure for 3.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: A small amount of pale yellow crystals was obtained in one reaction work-up; pure bulk material was not isolated.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion, Scheme 2 and eqn (2)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A pseudo-tetrahedral mononuclear Ce(III) silyloxide–silylamide anion paired with a cryptand-bound lithium cation.

synthesis.procedure: Observed as a photolysis product of 1. Independently prepared by reacting Ce(NR₂)₃ with LiOSiMe₃ in THF in the presence of 2,2,2-cryptand; the main article gives no numerical reagent quantities.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for reaction; −25 °C for crystallization
synthesis.time: 45 min before and 15 min after cryptand addition; 24 h crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirring under dinitrogen in a glovebox or on a Schlenk line
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The independent synthesis yielded a white solid after work-up; colorless plates from the photolysis mixture were also structurally identified.

title: Synthesis of a terminal Ce(IV) oxo complex by photolysis of a Ce(III) nitrate complex
